# What does HMRC say you sold?

> Free UK crypto capital gains calculator. Paste your buys, sales, swaps and staking income as a CSV and it applies HMRC's same-day, 30-day and Section 104 pooling rules, works out each tax year's gain, exempt amount and estimated CGT, and exports the working. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
